text: まっ　というわけで　しごとは　おしまいや！

structure.jp: まっ　というわけで
structure.en: well, so that's how it is, and

structure.jp: しごとは　おしまいや！

patterns.name: 〜というわけで
patterns.explanation: というわけで sums up what came before and moves on: 'and so'. というわけで = 'so, that being the case'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai dialect form of だ, 'is'. おしまいや = 'it's finished'.
